chunk.content: Island mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) supports a commercial fishery and an analysed value chain in coastal municipalities, e.g. in Lagonoy Gulf, Philippines; FishBase lists it as commercial and gamefish.
chunk.source_quote: Jamer, M. M. N., & Manzano, M. T. J. (2025). Value Chain Analysis of Island Mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) in Selected Coastal Municipalities in Lagonoy Gulf, Philippines. Jurnal Manajemen Dan Agribisnis, 22(2), 210.

source.title: Value Chain Analysis of Island Mackerel (Rastrelliger faughni) in Selected Coastal Municipalities in Lagonoy Gulf, Philippines
